enemies.name: Scamp
enemies.info: A small night creature. Each one that gets through costs a life.

enemies.name: Pip
enemies.info: Small, but comes in big crowds. Splash clears them.

enemies.name: Skitter
enemies.info: Very fast. Give it a long road, or make it drowsy.

enemies.name: Flitter
enemies.info: Flies straight over roads and gates. Not every tower can hit it.

enemies.name: Shellback
enemies.info: Its shell blocks 4 damage from every hit. Big hits get through.

enemies.name: Bubbler
enemies.info: Its bubble blocks one whole hit and returns in 2 seconds. Quick hits pop it.

enemies.name: Puffball
enemies.info: Bursts into 3 Puffs when popped. Splash catches them.

enemies.name: Puff
enemies.info: Three come out of every popped Puffball. Splash catches them.

enemies.name: Mender
enemies.info: Heals the creatures near it every 2 seconds. Stop it first.

enemies.name: Gatecrasher
enemies.info: Heads for your gates and breaks one open in 4 seconds.

enemies.name: Dusk Moth
enemies.info: An armored flyer. Small hits barely scratch it.

enemies.name: Grumblesack
enemies.info: Huge and slow. Drops 2 Scamps every 6 seconds.

enemies.name: Ironshell
enemies.info: Armor 10. It gets faster each time it loses a quarter of its health.

enemies.name: Moon Moth
enemies.info: A flying boss with armor 3. Every 6 seconds, 3 Flitters fly out.

enemies.name: Old Tusk
enemies.info: Armor 4. Breaks gates in 2 seconds. At half health, 4 Dusk Moths fly out.

enemies.name: Mossbud
enemies.info: Regrows a little health every second. Big hits beat it. Slows give it time.

enemies.name: Mistwisp
enemies.info: Others on its tile or beside it can't be aimed at. Splash still hits them.

enemies.name: Burrowbelly
enemies.info: Digs under, out of reach, for 2 seconds every 8. Comes up with 2 Mistwisps.

enemies.name: Gleamer
enemies.info: Every tower that can reach it aims at it. Others slip past.

enemies.name: Sleepyhead
enemies.info: Popped once, it naps for 2 seconds, then gets up with half its health.

enemies.name: Old Hayrick
enemies.info: Every tower aims at it. Popped once, it naps 3 seconds and gets up again.

enemies.name: Snowroller
enemies.info: Grows with every tile it walks, up to 3 times its health. Pop it early.

enemies.name: Yawner
enemies.info: Every 4 seconds it yawns, and towers right beside it doze for 2 seconds.

enemies.name: Snowsnore
enemies.info: Grows as it walks. Every 6 seconds it yawns and towers near it doze.

enemies.name: Blinker
enemies.info: Every 3 seconds it blinks 2 tiles ahead along the road.

enemies.name: Hootling
enemies.info: Its hoots keep everything near it awake. Nothing near it can be slowed.

enemies.name: Glimmertoad
enemies.info: Hops ahead every 6 seconds. Can't be slowed. At half health, 6 Flitters fly out.
